summary_text: The official website states that Oxford Reading Tree is the core of the reading programme in Lower Primary, but this has no independent corroboration. The claim is sourced from the official school website and outlines the Year 1 and Year 2 science curriculum regarding living things, materials, and seasonal changes, but lacks independent corroboration. The official website indicates that all classes participate in Myanmar Language twice a week covering reading, writing, listening, speaking, and culture, but this is based on a single official source without independent corroboration. The curriculum details are provided by an official source but lack independent corroboration.
